dependency_semantics.hard_edge_format: Each hard predecessor names predecessor pico and stage, the dependent stage and the evidenced reason. Stage edges avoid falsely requiring runtime closure before source composition.
dependency_semantics.acceptance_dependency_format: An acceptance dependency is a final proof join only; it is not a source-authoring or import blocker.
dependency_semantics.unlisted_edges: No prerequisite is inferred between unrelated groups. Original contract depends_on edges are retained by reference and apply only within their original scope.
dependency_semantics.all_items_stages: Only stages explicitly named by a matrix edge are scheduling nodes. The pico outcome remains subject to its listed remaining original proof.

coverage_totals.meaning: Coverage counts only, never PASS or completion counts.

item_defaults.execution_binding: Existing owning proof and current candidate/input/config; no new command or run grant.
item_defaults.unknown_acceptance_owner: Codeleader binds actual original consuming owner and independent verdict actor; no inferred reassignment.

original_consuming_owner.runtime: Per-consumed-proof actor/input/config binding required; no inferred reassignment

current_repair_authors.author_binding: Exact author and release remain in cited candidate/allocation

path_group_defaults.coverage_state: Existing row dispositions preserved; grouping neither requires rewriting every path nor claims semantic/runtime acceptance.
